task.objective: Reschedule my apartment cleaning service appointment

existing_service.service_description: Deep cleaning of 2-bedroom apartment before archival research trip

cancellation_policy.refund_policy: Full refund if cancelled at least 48 hours before the scheduled start time; 50% refund if cancelled 24–48 hours before.

persona.name: Claire Lévy
persona.occupation: Historian and lecturer in modern Jewish history
persona.bio: Claire Lévy is a Strasbourg-based historian specializing in the history of Jewish communities in Alsace-Lorraine and northeastern France. Her current research focuses on the reconstruction of the synagogue in Vitry-le-François, the fate of its community archives, and how Jewish life there shaped the city’s cultural memory in the 19th and 20th centuries. She has a patient, curious manner and loves weaving archival details into stories that make local history feel vivid and human.
persona.writing_style: Warm, precise, and professional; clear sentences, occasional parenthetical asides, open to dialogue and follow-up questions
sample_messages: Thanks for sending the inventory list. Do you know if there are any pre-war marriage registers from Vitry-le-François that weren’t digitized yet, especially around the 1890–1910 period?
I’ll be in Vitry on Thursday afternoon to photograph the synagogue’s interior and the memorial plaques—can someone from the mairie unlock the archive room between 14h and 16h?

Yes, that date works perfectly for the talk. I’ll focus on three points: the reconstruction of the synagogue, the role of the community’s archives, and how Jewish life has shaped the broader history of the town.
